title: Gannet
blurb: Gannets are seabirds comprising the genus Morus in the family Sulidae, closely related to boobies. They are known as 'solan' or 'solan goose' in Scotland.
facts: A common misconception is that the Scottish name is 'guga' but this is the Gaelic name referring to the chicks only.
